actual_scope: Prove that the selected hyperplane residual C7, defined only as a linear map on C^128, is a linear equivalence, so factor_iff_pre's invertible-residual hypothesis applies to hpe_word_exact. Do not reprove gL_adj or (N).
scope_change_reason: The card allows one formal lemma or one theorem-to-certificate binding. factor_iff_pre already proves abstract cancellation for an invertible residual. The selected C7 is declared as a linear map, and the in-repo HPE checkers never mention it, so the converse is not bound to this residual.
bottleneck_link: A wrong pre-wrapper is excluded by factor_iff_pre only when the residual is an equivalence. Discharging that hypothesis for the selected C7 closes one conditional gap in the hyperplane-end interface. It does not change the paid profile. The complex primitive remains binding, so kappa is unchanged.
stop_rule: Stop after the 128-dimensional residual and the pinned Lean definition lines. Do not run lake build, make frontier1094-verify, or an emitted-wrapper audit.
evidence: PASS_HPE_C7_RESIDUAL_EQUIVALENCE. Both two-sided inverses hold on all 128 basis vectors. Same-sign square, missing qubit 0, and the Z/6 shift-4 XOR predicate are rejected. Lean kernel not run. One addDiscussionComment on discussion 1166 returned FORBIDDEN and was not retried.
